prohibited_uses: treating historical TEST performance as current clean-v3 validation evidence
using historical TEST performance to tune the new project
rebuilding from scratch a component that already exists and is technically valid
policy.search_first_rule: Search the repository and legacy evidence before proposing any new Phase-19 implementation.

entries.old_role: Multi-domain dataset naming, modality + target definitions, per-domain root candidates
entries.current_intended_reuse: Dataset naming/modality vocabulary for the Phase-19 inventory
entries.reason: The legacy config targets a different domain set (KiTS/BraTS) and a 2.5D-3D stream; only the naming vocabulary transfers.

entries.old_role: 3-domain task-ID registry (isic2018=0, busi=1, kvasir=2), training hyperparameters, metric list
entries.current_intended_reuse: Independent corroboration of the task-ID mapping; metric-name vocabulary
entries.reason: Task IDs agree with manifests/phase4_v3; hyperparameters belong to a superseded pipeline and are NOT adopted.

entries.old_role: Orientation-aware image opening and radiograph-specific preprocessing
entries.current_intended_reuse: Orientation-handling lesson (EXIF/oriented open) for the harmonization contract
entries.reason: The current canonical transform already resizes/pads; only the orientation-handling lesson is portable.

entries.old_role: Content-hash based near-duplicate / entity grouping for leakage control
entries.current_intended_reuse: Leakage-safeguard design for cross-domain duplicate detection
entries.reason: The jup repo already remediated leakage in phase4_v3; the legacy approach is a design reference for additional cross-domain duplicate checks.

entries.old_role: Sparse CAM-seed weak-label dataset with 0/1..254/255 encoding
entries.current_intended_reuse: NOT adopted: the current program uses full ground-truth masks
entries.reason: The RA-MedFiLM-Seg++ program is fully supervised; importing the weak-label encoding would corrupt the mask contract.

entries.old_role: FeatureWiseLinearModulation: F_hat = (1 + gamma(t)) * F + beta(t), zero-initialised output projection (identity at init)
entries.current_intended_reuse: FiLM engineering reference for the Phase-25 RA-MedFiLM module
entries.reason: Zero-init identity-at-start is a valuable, verified engineering property; the exact implementation belongs to Phase 25 and must be re-validated there.

entries.old_role: Explicit locked-TEST contract with prohibited uses and a split fingerprint
entries.current_intended_reuse: Governance pattern for the Phase-39 TEST lock
entries.reason: The jup repo already has a stronger, independently verified TEST lock (src.utils.test_lock).

entries.old_role: Multi-dataset (isic2018, kits23, mms, montgomery) segmentation experiments
entries.current_intended_reuse: Prior evidence that a single model can span multiple medical domains; dataset-adapter lessons
entries.reason: Different domain set; no reusable code path. Historical numbers are not current clean-v3 evidence.

entries.old_role: External evaluation dataset engineering for the MedFiLM-Seg project
